name: Muchimuchi Sexy Parfait Onee-sama You
original_name: ムチムチセクシぃパフぇ お姉様用
source:
A sequel to Pompom Pretty Parfait Okosamayou.

A year has passed. The main character was returning to normal college life after winning the game of sales in the previous game. And when the university studies came to vacations, a letter arrived from his mother's friend requesting to help with managing coffee shop "Muchimuchi Parfait".

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/09/vn-of-month-march-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
这是《Pompom Pretty Parfait Okosamayou》的续作。

一年过去了。前作中，主人公赢下销售比赛后回归了普通的大学生活。大学迎来假期时，他收到母亲友人的来信，对方请他帮忙经营咖啡店“Muchimuchi Parfait”。

[译自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/09/vn-of-month-march-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
